pictures.name: ZSJ1-Dreamy-Boy
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. The edge of a Punjab village in the late 1400s: a boy of about ten in a simple white kurta, seen only from behind, sits very still under a big tree gazing at the sky, while in the background two grown men by a mud-brick house shake their heads at him. Gold afternoon light. The boy is the young Guru Nanak and is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.
